# Theme tools

The live theme editor and its parts.

[ThemeEditor](#themeeditor) · [ThemeDock](#themedock) · [ThemeToggle](#themetoggle) · [ColorField](#colorfield)

### ThemeEditor

The live theme editor: presets, light and dark palettes with contrast checks, gradient, chart colors, radius, widths, shadows, font, locale, currency, and JSON export, import and save.

```ts
import { ThemeEditor } from '@/kit/components/theme/ThemeEditor'
```

```tsx
<ConfigProvider saved={SAVED_CONFIG}><ThemeEditor /></ConfigProvider>
```

- Takes no props: it reads and writes the configuration through `useConfig()`, so it needs a `ConfigProvider` above it.
- Edits apply to the whole page as you type and are kept in this browser until saved. On the dev server “Save to project” writes the config file; elsewhere use Copy JSON.

### ThemeDock

A floating “Theme” button that opens the editor beside the page. A design-time tool: it only mounts on the dev server.

```ts
import { ThemeDock } from '@/kit/components/theme/ThemeDock'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `settingsPath` | `string` |  | Route of a full-page theme editor. When set, the dock links to it and hides itself there. |

```tsx
<ThemeDock settingsPath="/settings" />
```

### ThemeToggle

An icon button that opens a small menu: light, one of three night-blue dark styles (Deep ocean, Midnight, Twilight) or the system setting. The choice is kept in this browser like any other theme edit.

```ts
import { ThemeToggle } from '@/kit/components/theme/ThemeToggle'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<SiteHeader brand={<Logo />} actions={<ThemeToggle />}>…</SiteHeader>
```

- Reads and writes `theme.mode` and `theme.colors.dark` through `useConfig()`, so it needs a `ConfigProvider` above it.
- Choosing a dark style replaces the dark palette; the theme editor can still change single colors afterwards. The styles are in `NIGHT_STYLES` (`kit/theme/theme.ts`); the first one is the default dark palette.

### ColorField

A native color picker plus a hex input that only commits valid colors.

```ts
import { ColorField } from '@/kit/components/theme/ColorField'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `string` |  | Current color as #rrggbb. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(hex: string) => void` |  | Called with a valid #rrggbb color. |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` |  | Used for the accessible names of both inputs. |

```tsx
<ColorField label="Accent" value={accent} onChange={setAccent} />
```
